summary: Attempted a Cookbook RA for the '1P Drone Delivery MVP Dimensions & Eligibility Proposal' Confluence page; blocked because mcp-atlassian's Confluence content-fetch methods (get_page by ID/title, history, space tree, attachments, labels, search) all fail with 'Cloud object' AttributeErrors consistent with an atlassian-python-api version mismatch, while Jira calls and page-restrictions/comments endpoints work fine. Confirmed via get_page_restrictions + jira_get_user_profile that the user's account has read access, ruling out permissions. Escalated to Bonnie to paste page content directly or fix/upgrade the mcp-atlassian environment.
questions: Why did mcp-atlassian's Confluence content-fetch methods start failing when Jira-side calls still work?
What does Cookbook need to change to support 1P drone delivery MVP dimensions/eligibility?
learned: mcp-atlassian's Cloud wrapper in this environment is missing get_page_by_id, get_all_pages_from_space_raw, get_attachments_from_content, and get_page_labels, while get_content_restrictions and comment-listing still work.
confluence_search returns the Confluence web-app HTML shell instead of JSON for any query, another symptom of the same broken integration.
thinking: Ruled out title-guessing and permissions systematically (restrictions lookup + user profile cross-check) before concluding it's a tool/environment bug rather than user error.
followups: Resume the 1P Drone Delivery MVP Cookbook RA once page content is available (pasted or via fixed Confluence access).
Check/upgrade mcp-atlassian and atlassian-python-api version compatibility.
